attributes.rule: A change from any other heading, except from [heading 8503](/headings/8503).

A change from within any one of these heading or [heading 8503](/headings/8503), whether or not there is also a change from any other heading, provided that the value of non-originating materials classified in the same heading as the final product or [heading 8503](/headings/8503) does not exceed **50%** of the transaction value or ex-works price of the product.
